observations: body L1: the fraction ends the equation begun at the foot of p. 224: 1° 53′ × 60′ : 42′ 38″ = 2° 39′ 2″, the 2° 39′ that the line names.
body L6, L8: heavy brackets close the addition begun on p. 224 (L6) and open that of L8, which closes on p. 226.
body L6, L8, L15, L17-L18, L20, L22: the dashes of «al–Battānī», «28–30» and «’l–qarnayn» are long dashes (5.4 to 5.5 pt).

body L6-L8, L16, L28: the dashes before «Schiaparelli», after «d)» in the head, after «lunares.», before «Numerus» and before «Motus» measure 9.8 to 10.3 pt and are transcribed as dashes; that of «19–30» in the head is a long dash (5.4 pt).
body L10: the bar between ☾ and ⊙ (9.8 pt) is a minus sign.
body L16, L23: 3′ in a century make 22′ 30″ in 750 years. In L18-L19, 27′ × 1200 : 750 = 43′,2, near 3/4 of a degree (45′).

body L24, L34-L35: al-Battānī's motion in longitude exceeds Ptolemy's by 36′ 9″ in 100 years, 4° 31′ 7″ in 750 years; his motion in latitude falls short by 3′ 0″ in 100 years (L15), and his motion in anomaly is Ptolemy's (L11).

body L34: Ptolemy's daily mean motions (Almagest IV, as corrected there: in longitude 13° 10′ 34″ 58‴ 33⁗ 30 30, in anomaly 13° 3′ 53″ 56‴ 17⁗ 51 59, in latitude 13° 13′ 45″ 39‴ 48⁗ 56 37) give in 36 525 days 307° 21′ 37″,5, 198° 29′ 56″,3 and 82° 2′ 42″,8, as printed.
body L35: the hyphen of «Al-Battānī» in the table measures 3.4 pt.
notes_left L1, notes_right L2: the dash of «al–Battānī» is a long dash of the notes (4.3 pt); that before «Schiaparelli» measures 8.2 pt.
